item.title: All clear given for Yeager Airport bomb threat
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. (WOWK) — Yeager Airport was given the all clear after a bomb threat Saturday evening. Metro 911 told 13 News the alert came in around 5:14 p.m. Members of various local agencies were on site to investigate the possible threat, including the Kanawha County Sheriff's Office Bomb Squad. The airport was also evacuated. [...]

item.title: Mother says Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe has aphasia, recovery efforts continue
item.description: In the post, Melody said her son has "settled into a new normal over the past 6 weeks" while working in an in-patient rehab facility. She said he will be starting eight to 12 weeks of residential rehab soon.

item.title: OVERNIGHT: Propane leak prompts evacuations in Lost Creek
item.description: The leak was turned over to Southern States, who offloaded 252 gallons of propane and allowed the remaining vapor release from the tank. Those evacuated were allowed to return home, according to a separate Facebook post.
